name: Audit & compliance
summary: Tamper-evident audit trail, soft delete, and GDPR export and delete

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: COMPLIANCE_HASH_CHAIN
env.description: Enable hash chaining on the audit log. Makes tampering detectable at the cost of serialising audit writes.

env.name: COMPLIANCE_RETENTION_DAYS
env.description: Days before soft-deleted rows are eligible for purge. Audit entries are never purged by this.

env.name: COMPLIANCE_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS
env.description: Days audit entries are kept. Long by default: shortening it below your obligation is a compliance failure, not a storage optimisation.

env.name: NEON_BLOCKS_TRIGGER_SECRET
env.description: Shared secret authenticating trigger delivery. Neon does not sign trigger POSTs.

triggers.description: Purge soft-deleted rows past retention and expired audit entries. Off-peak and off the hour.

operations.title: POST /subject-links
operations.description: Declare where a data subject's rows live.

operations.title: POST /requests
operations.description: Open an export or erasure request.

operations.title: POST /purge
operations.description: Cron. TTL purge of soft-deleted rows.

operations.title: GET /health
operations.description: Liveness and readiness, backed by the block's v_status view.
